title: Simultaneous conversion of dialkyl phosphites to dialkyl phosphoric acids and SeO2 to Se nanoparticles in water and their anticancer properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,36213-36218
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04981D, Paper

Babak Kaboudin, Hesam Esfandiari, Ali Sabzalipour, Zahra Oushyani Roudsari, Fahimeh Varmaghani, Tianjian Zhang, Yanlong Gu
The reported method presents the conversion of selenium dioxide to valuable anticancer Se NPs (stabilize by β-cyclodextrin) and synthesis of industrially applicable dialkyl phosphoric acids from inexpensive materials.
